protocol.question: Can subthreshold non-running actions be independently recovered by repeated same-class predictions when action-specific production priors also support each window?
protocol.candidate: Same actor and history generation; raw fused top class is unchanged and score is >0.65 and <0.925; baseline final label is other; adjacent output windows are at most 0.65 seconds apart.
protocol.primary_two_window: Two consecutive eligible windows spanning at least 0.5 seconds; output begins at the second window, no retroactive output.
protocol.strict_three_window: Three consecutive eligible windows spanning at least 1.0 seconds; output begins at the third window, no retroactive output.

class_priors.wave: Existing pose prior must support each window.
class_priors.drink: Existing seven-class object prior at threshold 0.581 must support each window and obey luma gate 35.
class_priors.pick_up: Existing seven-class object prior at threshold 0.581 must support each window and obey luma gate 35.
class_priors.other_classes: No class-specific prior exists; temporal consensus alone is diagnostic and cannot establish correctness.

protocol.reset: A baseline-confirmed action, other/noncandidate top label, prior failure, identity/generation change, or gap above 0.65 seconds resets the streak.
protocol.data: Old frozen windows plus 10/25 crowded labels and user-confirmed 13 recovered windows. Do not treat pseudo-other, excluded, conflicted, or unlabeled windows as ground truth.
protocol.reporting: Separate old train/validation/test and crowded train/validation/test; report windows and action groups separately; unknown outcomes remain unknown.
protocol.promotion: No production changes or parameter promotion in this experiment.
